name: nostrbuild
description: Assets for the PHP pages still served by nostr.build: /delete's script and the Tailwind CSS of /delete and /freeview

scripts.build: rm -rf ../scripts/dist && esbuild src/delete.js --bundle --minify --outdir=../scripts/dist --format=esm --target=es2020 && tailwindcss -o ../styles/twbuild.css --minify && npm run update-versions
